conversation.availability: Provided conversation context, not a public authenticated transcript.
conversation.date_policy: Unknown event timestamps stay null; sequence captures available discussion order. Same-day conversation items have date-only precision.
conversation.retrospection_policy: Summaries are attributed to the original speaker and separately to the recorder. Quotes are short excerpts; summary language is never presented as an original quotation.
